verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor documentation describing dedicated migration tooling (e.g., importing from GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket, bulk user import) for moving code and users from another platform or to a cloud instance. In fact, community reports directly contradict this capability: one user found migrating existing git repos into Gitea 'surprisingly difficult' [gitea-comm-16], and another cites Gitea's backup/restore mechanism as 'still not being good' and a blocker for migrating from Gogs [gitea-comm-20]. Missing for 10: any first-party migration/import documentation, evidence of successful cross-platform user/data migration, and independent confirmation the process works smoothly.
